When scheduled and random quizzes expire automatically, Dilemma now posts their saved correct answer and explanation in the quiz channel. Results are also published for polls without votes, after Discord finalizes the poll.

- Share result delivery with manual closing to protect against duplicate messages when both paths run concurrently.
- Persist pending delivery and retry after temporary Discord failures or bot restarts. Award finalized points independently, without awarding them again during delivery retries.
- Preserve the answer and point value recorded when the quiz was published, even if its topic difficulty changes later.
- Keep deadline-based scheduling without periodic database polling. Update README and add coverage for six languages, zero votes, concurrent closing, failed-send rollback and restart recovery.

Apply `20261028120000_automatic_quiz_results` and regenerate the Prisma client before starting this version. Existing completed settlements are excluded from automatic replay, so upgrading does not flood channels with old result messages. Discord command definitions are unchanged.

Migration and concurrency checks use disposable PostgreSQL 18 databases with synthetic fixtures, without production environment files, credentials or records.
